title: Esagila
source: Published excavation outline and Protomaps archaeological-site point
axis: +X plan east, +Z plan south, +Y up. Y=0 at the represented Nebuchadnezzar floor.
identityStatus: The recorded survey perimeter is aligned to the named PMTiles excavation pit, which is visible in the published aerial. The printed north arrow supplies the approximate plan bearing. The 29.85 m floor is the midpoint of two excavated stamped floors.
